classdef.name: DataMergeQrcodePlaceholders
classdef.shortdesc: A collection of data merge QR code placeholders.

method.name: add
method.shortdesc: Creates a data merge QR code placeholder.

parameter.name: placeholder
parameter.shortdesc: The page item on which to place the placeholder.

parameter.name: field
parameter.shortdesc: The data merge field to insert.

parameter.name: withProperties
parameter.shortdesc: Initial values for properties of the new DataMergeQrcodePlaceholder (Optional)

method.name: count
method.shortdesc: Displays the number of elements in the DataMergeQrcodePlaceholder.

method.name: item
method.shortdesc: Returns the DataMergeQrcodePlaceholder with the specified index or name.

parameter.name: index
parameter.shortdesc: The index or name. Can accept: Long Integer or String.

method.name: itemByName
method.shortdesc: Returns the DataMergeQrcodePlaceholder with the specified name.

method.name: itemByRange
method.shortdesc: Returns the DataMergeQrcodePlaceholders within the specified range.

parameter.name: from
parameter.shortdesc: The DataMergeQrcodePlaceholder, index, or name at the beginning of the range. Can accept: DataMergeQrcodePlaceholder, Long Integer or String.

parameter.name: to
parameter.shortdesc: The DataMergeQrcodePlaceholder, index, or name at the end of the range. Can accept: DataMergeQrcodePlaceholder, Long Integer or String.

method.name: firstItem
method.shortdesc: Returns the first DataMergeQrcodePlaceholder in the collection.

method.name: lastItem
method.shortdesc: Returns the last DataMergeQrcodePlaceholder in the collection.

method.name: middleItem
method.shortdesc: Returns the middle DataMergeQrcodePlaceholder in the collection.

method.name: previousItem
method.shortdesc: Returns the DataMergeQrcodePlaceholder with the index previous to the specified index.

parameter.name: obj
parameter.shortdesc: The index of the DataMergeQrcodePlaceholder that follows the desired DataMergeQrcodePlaceholder.

method.name: nextItem
method.shortdesc: Returns the DataMergeQrcodePlaceholder whose index follows the specified DataMergeQrcodePlaceholder in the collection.

parameter.name: obj
parameter.shortdesc: The DataMergeQrcodePlaceholder whose index comes before the desired DataMergeQrcodePlaceholder.

method.name: anyItem
method.shortdesc: Returns any DataMergeQrcodePlaceholder in the collection.

method.name: everyItem
method.shortdesc: Returns every DataMergeQrcodePlaceholder in the collection.

method.name: toSource
method.shortdesc: Generates a string which, if executed, will return the DataMergeQrcodePlaceholder.
Returns the DataMergeQrcodePlaceholder with the specified index.

property.name: length
property.shortdesc: The number of objects in the collection.
